overall_assessment: Reviewed all 18 sampled courses (14 suspects, four random controls) in full as displayed, plus both attendance appendix items: 2 correct and 0 wrong (covering all 5 moved sentences/plans); packet-builder truncation is not an extractor defect. The FHS prerequisite and teaching heading fixes hold in the displayed mappings, but high-severity semantic misclassification remains, including missed mandatory attendance, coursework/assessment confusion, mixed blocks and duplicated teaching text; random controls show additional unflagged defects. Empty flags mostly identify real placeholders, while Selvvalgt, both CBU1503 teaching leak flags and admission-worded passed-course requirements are false alarms; no duplication of moved attendance was demonstrated.

findings.suggested_fix: When an assessment paragraph explicitly defines arbeidskrav and states that they do not count toward the grade, move the defining paragraph and its explanatory continuation together with the approval-gate sentence, stopping at the final-exam description.

findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Arbeidskrav subheading maps the entire mixed block to coursework_requirements, without distinguishing the final assessed thesis from preliminary approvals.
findings.suggested_fix: Split this FHS thesis block at Arbeidet skal presenteres skriftlig i form av en oppgave and route the final thesis and word-limit paragraphs to assessment; keep preparatory proposal and other non-graded requirements in coursework_requirements.

findings.description: Non-sectional administration survives: FHS8004 prerequisites include target-group/admission material, unspecified qualifying degrees and security clearance rather than subject-matter prior knowledge, making its long flag substantive. Its course_content includes fees, travel/accommodation, equipment and dated meeting schedules. Random MILM2408 retains a clearance condition in course_content, while AR301 retains a workload-only sentence there. These should remain only in the full plan; genuine teaching arrangements and literature provisions must be retained in their proper sections.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R admission/noise cleanup covers only some formulations and sections; unmapped Andre praktiske opplysninger and blanket supplemental course_content mapping allow administrative paragraphs to survive.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip target-group, security-clearance, fee/accommodation, equipment, dated schedule and workload-only spans from emitted sections. Treat mixed practical-information blocks by paragraph, first preserving attendance as coursework, teaching as teaching_methods and actual literature information as reading_list.
